theorems.name: Submission.p10_17ae7b7d_pde_holomorphic_extension
theorems.statement: ∀ (w : ℝ) (g : ℂ → ℂ), 0 < w → DifferentiableOn ℂ g {z : ℂ | 0 < z.im} → (∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → g (z + (w : ℂ)) = g z) → (∃ C Y : ℝ, ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → Y ≤ z.im → ‖g z‖ ≤ C) → ∃ A : ℂ → ℂ, DifferentiableOn ℂ A (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1) ∧ (∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → g z = A (Complex.exp (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I * z / (w : ℂ))))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
